jobs.description: Stardew Valley warm 16-bit pixel art, Terraria side-view front-view, limited palette, 1px hard outlines, no anti-aliasing, no watermark, ONE complete underground mine CELL, taller than wide, NOT a landscape. OUTER CONTOUR: thick dark cave-rock rim completely surrounding all four sides like a window into a dug-out shaft. INSIDE the rim: a clear 3-columns by 4-rows grid of square ore tiles (exactly 12 tiles), grey packed stones, some tiles have gold chunks embedded, thin dark grid lines between tiles. Front-view cross-section, no character, no sky, no house, no tree, no well, no text, no readable letters, compact 64 by 80 canvas, the rim is about 4 pixels thick
